• Thu Nov 5 — 9:00am, 11:30am, 4:00pm

If none of these fit, tell me two windows that work for you Tue–Fri in your local time and your timezone (so I can convert). If scheduling is tight, we can also trade a short Loom intro instead.

I've attached the resume we have on file for quick reference and looped in Aditya (hiring manager) and Laura (recruiter support).

Best,
